deviations: Idempotency receipt is a process-local in-memory map keyed by (organization, request_token) storing the input digest plus plan/result, because this slice must not create a business table and no reusable receipt table exists; it is therefore non-durable across processes/restarts and is disclosed in the report (spec allows reporting this limitation instead of creating a table).

PM dataset scope: pm may export ops_overview, settlement_coverage and fee_pairing because those read services scope rows to visible managed projects; cash_bridge is denied for pm because bank/cash facts carry no project attribution (same limitation disclosed by PH-279/PH-288), rather than leaking company-wide cash.

The browser uses the single canonical ops-export/ history_read route for both the preview page and the CSV download (download=1); there is no POST/write route. The download response is streamed from memory with Content-Disposition and an X-Content-SHA256 header, not persisted to a temp file.

CSV layout: UTF-8 BOM, one header row, dataset rows, then a #checksum row carrying dataset/as_of/period/row_count/sha256/generated_at; content_id is the same sha256. Checksum is computed over the data body plus row count/as_of/period, so repeated identical exports are stable.

Export composes the delivered read services without re-deriving business rules: ops_overview -> operations_read_services.ops_reconciliation_overview; settlement_coverage -> settlement.coverage_read_services.open_item_coverage_snapshot; cash_bridge -> cash.reconciliation_services.cash_bridge_snapshot; fee_pairing -> costing.bank_charge_pairing_services.bank_charge_pairing.
The read path writes no generic audit (optional in the spec) and no receipt/session persistence beyond the in-memory token map; no verify_integrity assertion is changed or added.
Counterexamples and tests never UPDATE/DELETE historical rows; the export itself is read-only, so append-only triggers are untouched.

Single worker owns the whole write set (delivery export service/views/forms/domain metadata/template, delivery urls, two test files, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.

Reviewer round-1 token/HTTP fixes: the request-token cache now stores plan and result separately and selects by dry_run, so dry_run->real returns the real CSV/content_id and real->dry_run returns a plan without csv/content_id; the plan carries its token and the download URL reuses it, so plan->download is a same-input replay with the same X-Content-SHA256 (regressions added for both service and HTTP).
